craft_notes: Sthāyin: intoxication (unmattā — method, not lapse). Sanskrit first: state (nectar-drunk), act (brews changes), material (many-births stained harvest) → L4 sets state+act line 1, material line 2. Rows: row 8 (warm vowels drunk/change/strange — the haze sung). Rupture: colon after 'change' — brewing done, harvest named. Close: end-weight on distance ('far and strange' — many births felt). Minimal pass: 'harvest' for yatkṛtam (what-was-done as harvest, singable); malatraya surface-kept ('stained'). Read aloud: line 1 sways (drunk/brews/change), colon, line 2 gathers (old/far/strange). Rejected: 'crazy' for unmattā — killed: intoxication is nectar's, madness pathologizes; resolving malatrayavikārau — killed at L0 (surface kept, emendation refused).

lines: Drunk on nectar, she brews change on change:
old births' stained harvest, gathered far and strange.
l4.sanskrit_cite: amṛte seyam unmattā vikārān kurute bahūn / malatrayavikārau bahujanmasu yatkṛtam

reads_against.argmap: Drunk on nectar she multiplies changes — the residue of many births' stained doing.
c1_essence: Nectar-drunk she multiplies changes: many births' stained doing fermented.
